name: Dumbbell Close-Grip Push-Up
steps: Place two flat-sided dumbbells parallel and close together on the floor beneath your chest.
Grip both handles firmly and step your feet back into a straight high plank.
Bend your elbows alongside your ribs to lower your chest smoothly toward the handles.
Press firmly through both dumbbells until your arms straighten back to the plank.
tips: Check that both dumbbells stay flat and stable before placing weight on them.
Keep your core braced and hips in line with your shoulders throughout.
